text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated latencies and increased 5xx rate observed for cont-batch workers in us-west-2. Metric spike: kv-cache eviction-rate up x7, contbatch queue depth rising. Auto-threshold triggered at 2024-06-03T15:12:01Z.

Joel (oncall): I'm on it, taking first ownership. Looking at dashboards and logs. Any customer reports so far?

Sam Support: Getting a handful of support pings, mostly timeouts in long-chat sessions (>3k tokens). A customer reported repeated generation truncation. No billing anomalies reported.

Katie SRE: Observed contbatch worker group contbatch-usw2-2 with sustained backlog. max_batch_tokens currently 4096, max_num_seqs 64. KV cache hitrate dropped from ~92% to ~18% over the last 8m, eviction spikes and increased page faults in the runtime.

Dante Eng: That pattern smells like a kvcache blowup when a few huge requests thrash the cache and force paging. Any recent model config or routing rollouts?

Marie PM: Yesterday's route cleanup shouldn't affect runtime params. No config changes to contbatch in last 24h besides a minor scheduling tweak.

Joel (oncall): Prioritizing mitigation: plan to patch pool to reduce max_batch_tokens -> 2048, cap max_num_seqs -> 32, and tighten response timeout to 12s to fail fast. Will canary to 2 pods then roll.

Joel (oncall): Applying hotfix now:
```bash
redwood deploy-config --pool contbatch-usw2-2 \
  --set max_batch_tokens=2048 \
  --set max_num_seqs=32 \
  --set response_timeout_ms=12000
```

ops-bot: Deploy started by Joel. Change ID: cfg-20240603-9987. Canary target: contbatch-usw2-2/canary.

Katie SRE: Canary metrics: p95 latency down ~220ms -> ~80ms, queue depth reduced by ~60%, eviction-rate trending down. No new 5xx from canary nodes.

Dante Eng: Good. Also adding temporary routing rule to divert super-long contexts (>2000 tokens) to a smaller model to avoid inducing K/V page churn.

Joel (oncall): Routing snippet applied (temporary):
```json
{"route":"long_context_fallback","threshold_tokens":2000,"target":"redwood-small-v1","duration":"1h"}
```

Sam Support: Posted initial status to customers: "Mitigation in progress, routing for long contexts applied, reducing timeouts. Monitoring closely." Responses are appreciative; a couple asked for ETA on full resolution.

ops-bot: Rollout complete across pool in 7m. Change ID cfg-20240603-9987. All nodes healthy.

Marie PM: Customer impact summary for incident channel: ~12 active customers experienced intermittent timeouts across ~87 sessions between 15:05-15:20 UTC. Severity: medium. Will prepare postmortem.

Dante Eng: Action items captured: 1) Add alert when kv-cache hitrate <50% for 10m; 2) Implement an automatic transient-scaling rule to reduce max_batch_tokens when eviction-rate > threshold; 3) Add longer-tail perf tests that simulate few huge conversations + many small ones to reproduce thrash.

Joel (oncall): Creating ticket INC-2024-2345 and assigning to eng-runtime for root cause. Marking this thread as mitigated pending follow-up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Katie SRE: Leaving handoff to eng-runtime. @Dante Eng tagged for triage and heap/kvcache dumps.

Dante Eng: I have the ticket, will collect kvcache dumps and flamegraphs, plan to reproduce locally against a synthetic wide-distribution workload.

incidents-bot: Incident status changed: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Link: https://redwood/status/INC-2024-2345
